pipeline: trusted draw event with physical drawing seat and drawn-card UIDs
Solemn Wishes resolves 500 LP per eligible copy and returns a committed LP-gain event
caller atomically commits the gain and draw-event ledger
Fire Princess consumes the positive LP-gain event and returns 500 damage per eligible copy
caller atomically commits damage and a separate LP-gain event ledger

invariants.eventLedgers: Draw-event and LP-gain-event ledgers are separate even when they share the same stable eventId.
invariants.idempotency: Retries after both commits do not grant LP or inflict damage twice.
invariants.ownership: Physical owner seat and current controller team remain distinct.
invariants.privacy: Drawn-card UIDs are internal and never included in public summaries.
invariants.mutation: Both adapters are read-only; caller owns atomic LP/ledger commits.
invariants.zoneRules: 3+3 shared zones, separate Field Zone, Extra Deck 5, Deck 20–30 at construction, hand 6 with End Phase discard.

limitations: The trusted resolver must emit draw and LP-gain events with correct physical UIDs and event boundaries.
This integration test does not register either trigger in the central resolver or Discord command handler.
Solemn Wishes and Fire Princess remain outside the certified/playable catalog pending approved admission.
No merge, deploy, persistent DB write or player-data change.
